title: Historic Atlas — Your corner of the atlas
features: Personal-settings concept with read-only fictional identity, strict merge-only appearance preferences and CSRF-policy simulator, real local PNG/JPEG signature/size/dimension checks and centered 256px PNG avatar processing/download/removal, plus explicit Gravatar-policy preview without network.
limits: No real login, identity record, authorization or persistence. Profile is fictional, avatar processing runs locally in the browser rather than a secure backend. Never contacts Gravatar; policy dialog explains one-time backend copy. Account-deletion cleanup and full identity lifecycle are documented, not implemented.
